candidate_meaning.isolated_worker: VIA-owned Agent client in a supervised Rust worker process
candidate_meaning.same_process: the same VIA-owned Agent client inside the Rust Core process

fixed_context.semantic_model: one shared Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M local runtime; a paired A/B trial reuses one actual semantic source execution
fixed_context.input: one generated request WAV and one BlackHole input observation per paired A/B trial
fixed_context.downstream_agent: same external deterministic Reference Agent process and TCP contract
fixed_context.voice_renderer: same macOS Yuna renderer and BlackHole loopback
fixed_context.changed_axis: only the OS process boundary of the VIA-owned Agent client

correctness_breadth.membership: all cases whose execution or observation path physically crosses the Agent client

aggregation.latency: nearest-rank p95 and arithmetic mean over each 20-sample representative stratum
aggregation.correctness: strict case success and atomic field correctness over applicable breadth cases
aggregation.blast_radius: maximum excess affected independent user-visible units
aggregation.memory: nearest-rank p95 of candidate process-tree RSS plus the one shared local semantic runtime counted once
aggregation.trace: 100 * complete scored records / all scored records
aggregation.reproduction: exact independent analyzer reproduction from raw evidence

failure_treatment: All endpoint failures and timeouts remain in raw evidence; successful-sample filtering is forbidden.
